name: COVID Simulation
author: jliao1998
description:
University of Calgary - CPSC 581 Project 0

Some tips for playing this COVID Simulation:

First, we can do tests on mask/no mask, quarantine/no quarantine, compared how many days it takes to infect all the students.

Second, we can test the social distancing and contact time under mask/no mask, quarantine/no quarantine policy - test two extreme condition: (Distance = 0, Contact Time = 5) & (Distance = 5, Contact Time = 0). Test another situation that (Distance = 1 and Contact Time = 1, or any other value you can choose). This should be enough to showcase that social Distance has more weight in the infection.

Third, we can test vaccination percentage. Roughly test 10%, then 20%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90%, 95%, to demonstrate how it can achieve herd immunity (WHO suggested roughly 70%).

All of the simulation tests above have only one infectious student in the beginning.

Fourth, we can also test how fast it takes to infect all the students by putting more 'trojan horses'.
